findings.one_line: The proposal's iff causal-target identification claim is not delivered: this theorem proves certificate-pass identification but deliberately gives only factor-plane ambiguity, not observed-law-equivalent target separation, on failure; reposition the headline as a one-way sufficient identification result or derive the missing converse on a stated nondegenerate subclass.

This is only the immediate minimax-infimum upper-bound corollary of lem:pca-upper, not a minimax frontier or rate characterization; fold it into the estimator upper-bound result and position it as a new panel-specific sufficient guarantee, with comparison to the closest existing upper-bound theorem.

The load-bearing negative result names no specific published estimator, guarantee, or workflow that it refutes and its failure-driving target contrast is identically zero; it may be retained as an internal limitation, but cannot support a headline novelty claim without a named target and a nondegenerate/generic obstruction (subfield ceiling).

The explicit functional is evaluable, but the panel-factor deliverable lacks a stated technique-native sanity reduction (for example, collapse to the observed cohort mean under direct/perfect local recovery); add that reduction at the functional/theorem level.
